decisions: _http_get and _download_page cannot stay in the residue: the rune pull's _wiki_api and _process_runes read them, which is a back-edge. They are not rune facts either, because the Windows download_soup monkeypatch calls _download_page as well, so they get their own leaf, wiki_fetch.py, and both readers import it.

All seven wiki endpoint and page-title constants move, not the four the map names: _WIKI_API_URL, _WIKI_PAGE_URL, _WIKI_RAW_URL, _RUNE_TEMPLATE_PREFIX, _RUNE_PAGE_TITLE, _ADAPTIVE_TEMPLATE_TITLE and _RUNES_REFORGED_URL are each read only by the rune pull.

rune_roster imports download_json at call time. The vendored checkout reaches sys.path through the residue's bootstrap, and data_updater is the pull's one caller, so the deferred import is what lets rune_pull.py import on its own.
pyproject.toml's per-file-ignores gains rune_pull.py = [BLE001]: the three broad catches that re-report an untrusted wiki parse as data travel with the pull.

Published spelling: wiki_fetch's whole surface crosses a module boundary, so _http_get is http_get and _download_page is download_page. The vendor sys.path bootstrap is its own leaf, vendor_path.py, which both data_updater and rune_pull import, so download_json is a module-level import in each.
